question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as the stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold this signal into the broader assemble metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The patch is a public plugin API and SDK export change with real downstream motivation, but it can constrain future context-engine metadata design and still lacks live proof.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve this API shape, require the SDK baseline update and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof, then continue normal merge review.

options.title: Fold Into RFC
options.body: Pause or close this branch and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Private For Now
options.body: Avoid adding SDK exports until maintainers settle a stable plugin-facing token-budget helper contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this API shape, require the SDK baseline update and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof, then continue normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, authored the current head commits, and have recent merged ownership signals on the same context-engine budgeting path.
